eligibility: task has a completed OFF-only difficulty-screen run
task was not used in adopted-bridge development
at least one later rg/grep search reuses a structured identifier that frozen V3 can derive from prior tool outputs
selection_rule: sort eligible tasks by task_id ascending and take the first 6; if fewer than 6 are eligible, use all eligible tasks
interpretation: applicability-conditioned prospective holdout; selection may depend on pre-treatment adopted-bridge opportunity but not treatment outcome
